definition: The informal, fluctuating price index for black-market goods, labor, and services along the Great Lakes water corridors, negotiated in real time through water taxi networks and harbor brokers. Considered more honest than official Diaspora market indices by those who live by it.
origin: Harbor trader and smuggler cant, Old Harbor and lakeshore communities
usage: Used by traders, smugglers, Carrion Logistics independents, and off-grid labor brokers
example: "Forget the Tessera commodity board — skiff rate on refined chromite jumped thirty percent last Tuesday. Something big is moving."
